title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Elizabeth is a Lecturer on Law who teaches “Advanced Clinical Practice,” a capstone seminar for third-year students exploring complex concepts in legal services and social justice lawyering. She is a Clinical Instructor at the Harvard Legal Aid Bureau who teaches and supervises student attorneys in the Family and Wage & Hour Practices. Elizabeth works with […]
